Package org.dreambot.api.methods.construction

Class House

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.House
  • public class House
extends java.lang.Object

      Modifier and Type Method Description
      boolean isInside()
      Checks that the character is inside a player-owned house instance. XPE method.
      boolean isBuildingMode()
      Checks building mode for the current visit using varbit 2176 or a Build hotspot inside an instance. XPE method.
      boolean isBuildingModeDefault()
      Checks the building-mode setting for the next visit using varbit 14670. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject outsidePortal()
      Gets the loaded outside portal with the Build mode action, or null if absent. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject exitPortal()
      Gets the loaded exit portal without the Build mode action, or null if absent. XPE method.
      boolean enter()
      Uses Build mode on an outside portal within 20 tiles, or Inside on a Teleport to house tablet. Returns true if the character enters a house within 8 seconds. XPE method.
      boolean leave()
      Uses Enter on an exit portal within 8 tiles without walking. Returns true if the character leaves the house within 6 seconds. XPE method.
      boolean openOptions()
      Opens House Options from the Controls page in Settings with the bank closed. Returns true when House Options opens. XPE method.
      boolean closeOptions()
      Closes House Options. Returns true if the panel was already closed. XPE method.
      boolean isOptionsOpen()
      Checks whether the House Options Close control is visible. XPE method.
      boolean setBuildingMode​(boolean on)
      Changes building mode for this visit from inside the house, causing the house to reload. XPE method.
      boolean setBuildingModeDefault​(boolean on)
      Changes the default building mode for the next visit. Settings can be opened from outside the house. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject bellPull()
      Gets the rope, plain or posh bell-pull with the Ring action. XPE method.
      boolean ringBell()
      Clicks Ring on the bell-pull. XPE method.
      java.lang.String describeOptions()
      Describes the visible House Options rows for troubleshooting. XPE method.
